newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com buy rating reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com buy rating reiterated.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc said Tuesday it reiterated its buy rating on 3Com Corp, citing expectations the networking company will meet earnings expectations for its fiscal fourth quarter ending May 31 and post improving fiscal 1998 results.

- PaineWebber analyst Paul Weinstein said in published remarks received here that pricing pressures appear to be stabilizing. Weinstein said he expects 3Com fourth quarter earnings of $0.47 a share versus $0.48, and anticipates earnings comparisons will improve in fiscal 1998.

- 3Com, which has agreed to merge with U.S. Robotics Corp, could see systems sales increase because of apparent stablilized prices in the hub and switch sectors and elasticity in adapters, PaineWebber said.

- "Although the results are lackluster, this should be the last tough comparison and we expect earnings can accelerate throughout fiscal 1998, especially once 3Com combines with USRX," Weinstein said.
- PaineWebber also said it is more optimistic 3Com can withstand competitive pressure from Intel Corp in the adapter card segment.
- Shares of 3Com traded up 2-1/2 at 45-7/8. Shares of U.S. Robotics rose 4-1/4 to 79.
